title: Memory
summary: Notes, a small graph, vector search and an event log the agent can save to and search.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Remember a preference for later chats
Find what was said in an older session
Keep a dated log of events
risks: Notes persist on disk. Text saved here is later put into prompts, so do not store secrets in it.

title: Terminal and Python sandbox
summary: Run Python in a limited sandbox, with button approval for risky code.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Run a short calculation
Parse a CSV the user saved
Install a package in the sandbox venv (needs approval)
risks: The builtin sandbox is a limited subprocess, not a container or VM.

title: Shell
summary: A persistent bash shell on the host. Off unless the operator turns it on.
why_it_is_a_group: The shell is high risk, so only the operator can turn it on.
typical_uses: Run git or build commands in a workspace folder
Watch a long command
Answer a prompt from an interactive program
risks: Runs as the same operating-system user as the bot. Guard rules are not a security boundary.

title: Files
summary: Create, edit, list, delete and send files inside allowed folders. Core code is protected.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Write a note into the vault folder
Edit a file the agent made earlier
Send a file back into chat
risks: File protection covers these tools only. It does not cover run_code or the shell.

title: Skills
summary: Reusable Markdown instructions the agent can list, load, create and edit.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Save a workflow as a skill
Load a skill before a task
Search skills by keyword
risks: Skill text goes into prompts. Content that looks like prompt injection is rejected on save.

title: Web
summary: Search the web with DuckDuckGo and read public pages as text.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Look up a current fact
Read a documentation page
Find skill ideas
risks: Page text is untrusted. Suspicious text gets a warning banner, but it is not blocked.

title: Scheduled jobs
summary: Add, list and remove prompts that run on a schedule in the same chat.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Daily summary at a set UTC time
Check something every 30 minutes
Remove an old job
risks: Scheduled runs may only use a read-only list of tools.

title: Sub-agent notes
summary: Bookkeeping for delegated goals. It records a goal and a result. It does not run a second model.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Track a multi-part goal
List open goals
Mark a goal done with a result
risks: Records live in memory and are lost on restart. No separate worker runs.

title: GitHub
summary: Read repos, list issues and commits, and open issues through the GitHub API.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: List open issues
Read a file from a repo
Open an issue
risks: Needs a GitHub token in the settings. Issue creation changes things on GitHub.

title: Notifications
summary: Send a push message to the owner outside the chat, using ntfy.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Tell the owner a long job finished
Alert on a failed check
Send a daily reminder
risks: Needs a topic name in the settings. On the public ntfy server anyone who knows the topic can read it.

title: Voice
summary: Speak text as a voice message with Piper text-to-speech.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Read a summary aloud
Pick a voice
Send a short voice note
risks: Needs a voice model downloaded first. Output is a WAV file.

title: Session helpers
summary: A simple per-chat to-do list and a way to ask the user one clear question.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Track steps in a long task
Ask which of two options to use
Clear the list when done
risks: Low risk. The to-do list is stored per chat.

title: Routing
summary: Lets the agent hand a hard task to the stronger power model.
why_it_is_a_group: Tools with the same purpose and risk are switched together, so the model sees fewer tools.
typical_uses: Hand off a hard design task
Ask for a stronger model when unsure
Escalate after repeated failures
risks: The tool is only shown when a power model is set, auto routing is on, the low-confidence trigger is on and no tier is pinned.
